categories.name: single-cell
categories.description: Single-cell and single-nucleus RNA-seq: QC, integration, annotation and downstream analysis.

skills.name: qc-snrna-with-cellqc-standalone
skills.description: Run the CellQC pipeline (ambient correction, count/feature/mitochondrial filtering, doublet calling, nuclear fraction) over a cohort of 10x Cell Ranger libraries with plain bash and conda only, from installing cellqc to validating result/metrics.csv. Use when setting up a cellqc environment, staging Cell Ranger outputs, writing a cellqc config.yaml (including mitochondrial/ribosomal/hemoglobin gene sets for mouse or non-human references), running locally or under Slurm, or diagnosing a failed or inert QC run.
skills.tested_with: cellqc 0.3.6, Python 3.12.14, R 4.5.3, DoubletFinder 2.0.6, scDblFinder 1.24.10, SoupX 1.6.2, Seurat 5.5.1, Snakemake 9.22.0
skills.author: Jin Li

requirements.compute: 16 CPUs, 80 GB requested (25.6 GB peak), 20 min for 4 libraries
